title: How to use AI Tools to prepare for an interview 🔎
description:
By using some very simple ChatGPT prompts and the job description for the job you’ve applied to you have an awesome amount of interview prep right at your fingertips. You can have ChatGPT give you possible job interview questions and you can even have ChatGPT answer you questions. These aren’t guaranteed to be exact to your interview but they are a fantastic resource for practice. #jobinterview #jobinterviewtips #jobinterviewquestions #interview
